title: Chapter 324 Existence Above The Immortal Emperor Realm
content:
Chapter 324 Existence Above The Immortal Emperor Realm

After this incident, Lu Xue's name was completely famous from the Immortal Realm.

Not only did he kill Chen Mingyu, who was the 19th place in the demon list with his cultivation level in the Immortal Saint Realm, he also killed Ye Tian, the most powerful genius in the ancient Ye clan, with one blow. Such a record was amazing.

She is even praised by countless people as the most promising daughter of heaven who has the most hope of surpassing Xiao Yin in millions of years.

Afterwards, Lu Xue did not disappoint the world.

Tens of thousands of years have traveled from the fairyland, and have made great achievements.

On this day, Lu Xue finally ushered in her imperial disaster.

After tens of thousands of years of precipitation, Lu Xue successfully broke through from the battle and even killed the second place in the monster list. For a moment, she was incredible.

Rumble!

Looking at the terrifying clouds of disasters that are constantly condensed in the void.

At this moment, there was no trace of turmoil in Lu Xue's eyes.

Soon, the huge thunder tribulation suddenly fell straight from the catastrophe cloud, hitting the spiritual cover of Lu Xuetian.

Lu Xue remained motionless and took action in a tough way.

At this moment, the clouds of disasters cover more than tens of millions of miles, and the sun isolates the hearts.

The thunder tribulation even fell twelve thunder tribulations in a row, breaking the record of imperial tribulation in the immortal world.

I don’t know how long it took, as the smoke dissipated, Lu Xue slowly walked out of the smoke and dust.

Early stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

"Have you finally reached the Immortal Emperor Realm?"

Lu Xue clenched her fists, feeling the power that was countless times stronger than before, and a long-lost smile appeared on Lu Xue's face.

Ao Qing came from afar and felt sincerely happy for Lu Xue.

However, at this time, the void suddenly changed drastically.

Buzz —

The heaven and earth tremble.

The aura that seemed to be the revival of the ancient giant beast rushed out, filling the entire world.

"Who gives you the courage to kill my disciple?!"

A highly powerful and angry voice came straight from the void and crushed towards Lu Xue.

In an instant, Lu Xue's face was bloodless, and her powerful pressure almost crushed her.

Before the person arrives, the breath is already so terrifying.

At this moment, Lu Xue naturally guessed who the person was.

Of course, she was the second-ranked master on the list of monsters she just killed.

These are all so short-sighted.

And at this time, the void cracked.

Immediately afterwards, a destructive aura came to his face.

This aura is a strong man above the Immortal Emperor Realm!

In an instant, Lu Xuexin fell to the bottom.

Because there is no such strong man on her side who can help her.

Not long ago, there was some turmoil outside the fairy world, and several top-level strong men came out of seclusion to check.

Among them are the president of Tiandi Academy and the ancestor of Xiao clan.

If these two are there, Lu Xue doesn't have to worry.

Just now,

At this time, a beautiful woman slowly walked out of the crack in the void.

At this moment, his body exuded a hostility like a covering of the sky, looking extremely terrifying.

"It's you who killed my disciple!"

The woman said with a grim voice.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue said coldly: "It was your disciple who provoked me first, not to mention that I fought a fair decisive battle with your disciple. It was your disciple who was not as skilled as talented,"

"shut up!"

Before Lu Xue could finish her words, the woman snorted coldly.

In an instant, the terrifying pressure crushed Lu Xue again.

With a plop.

Lu Xue was directly pressed on the ground by this powerful force, unable to move, and her muscles and bones were clattering.

"Little Master!"

On the side, Ao Qing's eyes suddenly burst out when he saw this scene, but he was powerless.

Although he has reached the Immortal Emperor Realm now, it is still not enough to deal with the existence above the Immortal Emperor Realm.

"Today, no one can save you."

The woman sniffed coldly.

In response to this, Lu Xue's face suddenly became ferocious.

So what about it above the Immortal Emperor Realm.

boom!

In an instant, an extremely powerful aura suddenly burst out from Lu Xue's body.

Lu Xue immediately broke free and rushed towards the woman in the void.

"The true secret of Bingfeng!"

Buzz —

At this moment, time and space seemed to be frozen by this sword.

Facing the strongest sword Lu Xue has ever seen, the woman smiled disdainfully.

"The flock shakes the tree."

boom!

As the woman slashed out with her palm, Lu Xue's body suddenly fell from the air as if she was struck by lightning.

Until Lu Xue hit the ground and splashed with dust.

At this moment, Lu Xue was covered in blood and looked extremely miserable.

There was even blood bleeding at the corners of my mouth.

At this moment, Lu Xue looked at the void in a daze, feeling a little dazed.

In a flash, so many years have passed.

But I seemed to have fallen down again.

Maybe she can really survive now just by calling daddy to help her.

But she didn't do that.

As for why, she wasn't very clear.

After a long silence, Lu Xue suddenly smiled and then slowly closed her eyes.

Seeing this, the woman sneered, "Have you given up? Yes, just an ant. Do you really think that you have some talent to do whatever you want? Don't worry, I won't kill you, I will imprison you and torture you forever!"

And at this moment, the void changed again.

Buzz —

I saw a dazzling golden light slowly emerged from the end of the void.

The next moment, a figure appeared not far away in front of the woman without any warning.

"Old woman, I haven't seen you for many years. Have you become bullied by a junior?"

Seeing the figure in front of him, the woman looked gloomy.

"Jin Shiyuan, what does this have to do with you?"

The person who came was Jin Shiyuan, who was the first in the Immortal Emperor List, and the strongest person in the Golden Immortal World.

Hearing this, Jin Shiyuan sneered, "I just think you are unhappy. What can you do?"

Suddenly, the old man's face became even more gloomy, but the look at Jin Shiyuan showed a little fear.

At this time, the powerful people of the Xiao clan and the powerful people of the Tiandi Academy also came here.

"Sister Xue, I'll bring someone to save you!"

Xiao Luo said in panic.

Qin Feng is beside him.

At this moment, not only Xiao Luo, but the rest of the people were the same.

This is only the case for those who know Lu Xue’s real background.

If Lu Xue really had any accident, they would be implicated.

Seeing that more and more people were from the other party, and even more Jin Shiyuan was eyeing him, the woman looked at Lu Xue who was lying on the ground with hatred, and then said hoarsely: "Wait, one day, I will take her life."

After saying that, the woman disappeared directly.

Seeing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

"Sister Lu Xue, thank you for helping you."

Lu Xue recovered a little at this moment and saluted Jin Shiyuan with a trembling salute.

At this time, she was also a little confused.

She didn't recognize this senior, so why did she save her?

As for what Jin Shiyuan said that she couldn't stand the woman, she wouldn't believe it.

"Thank you for your help, senior."

At this time, the other strong men also saluted Jin Shiyuan respectfully.

There are not many terrifying existences above the Immortal Emperor Realm.

At this time, Jin Shiyuan was also looking at Lu Xue.

Looking at Lu Xue's familiar face, he felt a little more convinced.

"No need to thank you. I guess you are very confused about why I saved you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded slightly.

In response, Jin Shiyuan smiled slightly, "I had some connection with your father back then, and you were also the son of an old friend, so you should help me."

As soon as these words came out, Lu Xue couldn't help but be slightly stunned.

This man can actually deal with his father.

Everyone in the Xiao clan was also shocked.

It turns out that the senior in front of him is also an acquaintance with that person.

"You are very good. Although you are not as good as your father, you are also very excellent. I like you. If you need it in the future, you can come to me."

Jin Shiyuan laughed and then left casually.

On the spot, a golden coin suddenly appeared in Lu Xue's hand.

In this way, there was another terrifying strong man behind Lu Xue, who walked around the world without any worries.
